label: Assumptions, not measurements. These cases are publishable working assumptions for an in-vehicle Westgate–Airport comparison until timed rides exist in ride_logs. They are not observed Loop trip times.
exclusion_note: Waiting for a ride and boarding are excluded on both sides.

segment.name: Westgate Las Vegas to 4744 Paradise Road, then surface to Harry Reid International Airport Terminal 1
segment.tunnel_distance_note: The Boring Company's November 25, 2026 post describes 2.3 miles starting at the Westgate Resort and ending across from UNLV's Thomas & Mack Center (and then to the airport). Steve Davis told the Las Vegas Review-Journal on January 9, 2026 that the under-construction segment was a 2.2-mile dual-direction tunnel from Westgate to a station planned at 4744 Paradise Road. The cases below use 2.3 miles so the Low running time matches 2.3 mi / 60 mph. The 2.2-mile figure is cited, not discarded.

low.in_tunnel_run_basis: 2.3 miles at the planned 60 mph University Center Loop speed limit (Steve Davis to the Las Vegas Review-Journal, January 9, 2026). Arithmetic: 2.3 / 60 hours = 2.3 minutes. This assumes travel at the planned limit for the whole distance. Acceleration and deceleration are not published.

mid.in_tunnel_run_basis: The 2.3-minute limit-speed running time plus about 40 seconds of acceleration and deceleration. The 40-second allowance is an assumption; acceleration and deceleration times are not published.

high.in_tunnel_run_basis: 2.3 miles at the 35 mph operating limit Davis said applies to the existing convention-center, Encore, Resorts World, and Westgate portions (Las Vegas Review-Journal, January 9, 2026). Arithmetic: 2.3 / 35 hours ≈ 3.9 minutes, rounded to 4.0 minutes in this case.

surface_leg.note: Under the January 2026 Phase 2 description, the trip from 4744 Paradise Road to the airport is still an above-ground leg until a later on-airport station exists. The in-vehicle comparison adds a live TomTom sample from these routes to the assumed in-tunnel run. Do not invent a surface-leg time.

in_vehicle.note: Waiting for a ride and boarding are excluded on both sides. The 2 to 8 minute company-published range on the official Vegas Loop project page is a system-wide range, not a measured Westgate-to-airport time, and is not used as an input to these cases.
